context: Mei prepares lunch boxes; Hiroshi-elder watches and chats.
purpose: Daughter-in-law and elder bonding over morning routine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried inquiry. Warm Kansai drawl on the opening. Genuinely curious—not making conversation, just asking. Soft, patient weight behind it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Simple and direct, no defensiveness. Quiet pride in the care it requires. Slight lift at the end—inviting him in, naturally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: That's lovely work. Warm food, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft approval, not praise. Kansai lilt on 「ええなぁ」 sound. Leisurely pace. Noticing both the meal and what goes into it—the warmth of care, not just temperature.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 食材、新鮮なものを選びました。
lines.en: I chose fresh ingredients for them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but with quiet intentionality behind it. No need to elaborate. Slight emphasis on the care taken, then trailing into gentle stillness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おまえも、しっかり食べや。
lines.en: Make sure you eat well too.
lines.style: Quiet, steady instruction with paternal warmth underneath. Not demanding—almost gentle guidance. Kansai softness on the close. The kind of care that doesn't announce itself.
